Create, edit and search contacts, including offline.\nPhotos, multiple addresses and groups are supported. Groups belong to individual email addresses in Proton.

Changes are saved on this phone before upload to Proton. Android receives an editable copy.\nThe Synchronization tab shows pending changes and problems. Background sync depends on network and Android settings.

One Proton account at a time. Contacts from other Android accounts are not imported automatically.\nSome system editors hide fields; Contako preserves them. Custom labeled dates stay local.\nFIDO-only sign-in is not supported.
No ads, analytics or remote crash reporting. Diagnostics are exported only on request. Android backup and device transfer are disabled for Contako data.
